menu_options.pair_sensor: Pair a validated HCS026 test sensor

authenticate_gateway.title: Authenticate standalone gateway
authenticate_gateway.description: This is only needed for a gateway running outside Home Assistant. Add-on credentials are configured automatically during discovery.

add_radio_node.title: Add custom local radio node
add_radio_node.description: Register the stable node ID and 64-character setup token shown by the provisioned ESP32 firmware. The credential is stored privately by the custom local gateway.

pair_sensor.title: Pair a validated HCS026 test sensor
pair_sensor.description: This prototype currently supports only the evidence-backed HCS026 test-sensor profile. Temporarily unplug the original RainPoint gateway, then select the custom local radio node nearest the sensor.

pairing_progress.title: Waiting for sensor
pairing_progress.description: With the original RainPoint gateway unplugged, hold the sensor button until the LED flashes. Home Assistant will continue automatically after terminal confirmation.

sensor_details.title: Sensor discovered
sensor_details.description: The local gateway validated sensor endpoint {endpoint}. Choose its Home Assistant name and area.

error.no_pairing_node: No authenticated pairing-capable local radio node is connected
